title: How the magic e changes a word
examples: Why is the e at the end of cake silent?

explain.say: Here is a little bit of magic. Look at the word cap, like a hat. Now watch what happens when one letter e jumps onto the end. It becomes cape, like a superhero cape!

draw.text: How the magic e changes a word

explain.say: Look at the first part: cap. The a makes its short sound, the first sound in apple. Cap. Pretend to put a cap on your head and say it.
Now the e at the end glows. It makes no sound of its own. Its magic jumps back over the p and makes the a say its name. Cap becomes cape. Can you hear the a saying its name?
It works with other vowels too. Kit, like a football kit, becomes kite! The magic e makes the i say its name. Draw a jump arrow from the e to the i with your finger.
Look at the pairs on the board: cap and cape, kit and kite, hop and hope, cub and cube. Magic every time! Brilliant work. Challenge: what does tap become with a magic e?

draw.name: x-sort
draw.question: What changes when e is added?

faq.a: It is an e at the end of a word that makes no sound itself. It makes the vowel before it say its name, so cap becomes cape.

faq.q: What does say its name mean?
faq.a: Each vowel has a name, like in the alphabet song: a, e, i, o, u. The magic e makes the vowel sound like its name.

faq.q: Does the magic e make a sound?
faq.a: No. The e at the end is quiet. Its job is to change the vowel sound before it.

faq.q: What words have a magic e?
faq.a: Lots! Cake, bike, home, cube, tape and kite all have one.

faq.q: How do I spot a magic e when I read?
faq.a: Look at the end of the word. If you see a vowel, then one consonant, then e, try saying the vowel name. A few words, like have and give, break the rule, and a teacher or grown-up can help with those.
asks: How do I know when e is magic?

facts: Adding an e to the end of cap makes cape, and kit becomes kite.
In words like cape and kite, the e at the end is silent.

quiz.say: What does hop become with a magic e?
quiz.why: The magic e makes the o say its name: hop becomes hope.

wrong.1: Hoop has two o letters and no e at the end.
wrong.2: Hip changes the vowel, but magic e only adds an e.

quiz.say: In the word kite, what sound does the e make?
quiz.show: What sound does the e in kite make?
quiz.why: The e is silent. It just makes the i say its name.

wrong.1: The magic e is quiet. It does not say the e in egg.
wrong.2: The magic e makes no sound of its own.
